title: October 2026 Cumulative Updates for Dynamics 365 Business Central
summary: October 2026 cumulative updates for Dynamics 365 Business Central are available, including Business Central 2026 Wave 2 release with version 29.0 for online customers and updates for on-premises versions 28.6, 27.12, and 26.18. Organizations should verify implementation readiness and compatibility with customizations before upgrading.
key_points: October 2026 cumulative updates released for multiple on-premises versions (28.6, 27.12, 26.18)
Business Central 2026 Wave 2 now available for new customers
Online customers auto-upgrading to version 29.0 with email notification
Recommend working with Microsoft Partner to assess upgrade readiness and customization compatibility

quotes.text: All new customers signing up from today will be on this release.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates when customers will start using the new 2026 Wave 2 version

quotes.text: Online customers will automatically be upgraded to version 29.0 over the coming days/weeks and should receive an email notification when upgraded.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the auto-upgrade timeline and communication method for cloud customers
